title: Cencora APS Expands Technology Ecosystem | Cencora
summary: Cencora’s Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions announced the expansion of its technology ecosystem.
body_markdown:
**CONSHOHOCKEN, Pa., \[Oct. 28, 2026\] —** Cencora’s[Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions](https://www.cencora.com/solutions/accelerate-pharmacy-solutions) , an integrated portfolio of pharmacy and supply chain solutions, today announced the expansion of its technology ecosystem to help health systems improve enterprise performance while streamlining patient access to medication.


“Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions remains focused on helping health systems manage more complexity than ever before,” said **David Tinsley, Senior Vice President & General Manager, Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions, Cencora.** “Our approach combines our core strengths in consulting, managed services and distribution infrastructure with continued investment in technology and data-driven capabilities. Through these investments, we’re helping organizations improve visibility and align strategy, operations and technology in a way that supports both enterprise performance and patient care.”


Fragmented systems leave clinicians spending[a significant portion of their time](https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/healthcare-and-pharmaceutical/clinicians-have-become-healthcares-human-middleware-new-vendor-agnost-1190832) on digital work, including procurement, billing, referrals, benefit verification and prior authorizations. Through direct customer feedback, Cencora anchored its technology ecosystem with Cencora Connect, a new digital front door designed to give health systems more centralized access to Cencora tools, services and partner-enabled technology capabilities. Through Cencora Connect, health systems can access solutions that support key pharmacy workflows to help achieve:


- **Enhanced digital capabilities to support pharmacy procurement:** New capabilities build on existing tools within Cencora’s procurement ecosystem, including solutions that support product ordering, marketplace access, order optimization and opportunity identification. Located within one dashboard, pharmacy teams can now view real-time analytics and intelligent purchasing insights together, enabling cost savings and faster, data-backed decisions.
- **Integrated technology to decrease time to therapy:** As physicians and staff[report](https://www.ama-assn.org/system/files/prior-authorization-survey.pdf) spending 13 hours per week on prior authorization paperwork, the enhanced[Cencora Benefit eServices](https://www.cencora.com/solutions/cencora-benefit-eservices) supports real-time benefit and prescription decision workflows, including electronic prior authorization and real-time prescription benefit capabilities. These solutions are designed to help providers and pharmacy teams access patient-specific coverage, formulary and prior authorization information within existing workflows, helping reduce manual effort and support faster access decisions.
- **Access to partners across the pharmacy ecosystem:** Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions is also integrating strategic partnerships to complement its in-house capabilities and accelerate the delivery of new solutions. As part of this approach, Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions is collaborating with[Plenful](https://www.plenful.com/?utm_source=press&utm_medium=prnewswire&utm_campaign=cencora-announcement-26) , a leading AI workflow automation platform built for pharmacy teams, expanding support to health systems with technology enabled solutions across several key areas including 340B automation, rebate management and pharmacy-related workflows. In addition, Cencora has combined its benefit verification and electronic prior authorization network with Plenful’s automation platform, helping health systems streamline intake authorization workflows, support regulatory and compliance optimization, reduce manual work and accelerate patient access to care.


“Health systems have never had more technology available to them, and with this has come a new level of complexity that very few organizations have the time, resources or capacity to resolve alone,” said **Cameron Laudick, Vice President & General Manager, Digital Innovation & Solutions, Cencora** . “In direct response to customers’ needs, we’re unifying digital tools, partner capabilities and expertise to help pharmacy spend less time on managing disparate systems and more time directly supporting patient care.”


[As the pipeline for specialty and emerging therapies continues to expand](https://www.iqvia.com/-/media/library/scientific-posters/fip-global-outlook-poster-vertical-orientation_final.pdf) , additional[investments](https://www.cencora.com/newsroom/aps-launches-cgt-enablement) are being made across core capabilities, technology infrastructure and strategic partnerships that enable health systems to better coordinate medication access across clinical, operational and financial functions.


Leaders from Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions and Plenful will also be at[Becker's 3rd Annual Fall Chief Pharmacy Officer Summit](https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/events/fall-cpo-summit-2026/) , Nov. 4-6. Conference attendees interested in learning more can visit Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions (booth #701) and Plenful (booth #502). For more information on how Accelerate Pharmacy Solutions is partnering with health systems to help build, grow and optimize their pharmacy and supply chain programs, visit:[https://www.cencora.com/solutions/accelerate-pharmacy-solutions](https://www.cencora.com/solutions/accelerate-pharmacy-solutions)
